component: CC-REG-01 — Open Claim-Checker for code-backed scientific claims
scope_correction: v1 described a news fact-check aggregator (ClaimReview + Google Fact Check Tools API). That can only look up claims journalists have already checked; it cannot test a new scientific or software claim, and it depends on a keyed, rate-limited Google API, so it is not un-gated. v2 checks claims by EXECUTING the evidence. ClaimReview is kept as the OUTPUT format.
access_tier: Open source, free; runs locally, no external API required

pipeline.name: static_scan
detects: HARDCODED_PASS: status literal not derived from results
PATTERNED_HASH: 'sha256' value that is a hand-typed sequence, not a digest

pipeline.name: receipt_recompute
pipeline.does: recompute every declared hash/manifest root from the files it claims to cover

pipeline.name: sandboxed_test_run
pipeline.does: run the project's own tests in isolation; record pass/fail, versions, seeds

pipeline.name: mutation_check
pipeline.does: remove each checked condition; a test that still passes is vacuous

pipeline.name: evidence_classification
pipeline.does: label each claim Specified / Simulated / Demonstrated / Independently Verified / Hypothesis (HMCR contract)

pipeline.name: claimreview_output
pipeline.does: emit schema.org ClaimReview JSON-LD with a machine-readable rating and links to the evidence run

true_positives: genesis engine v1: 2 literal VERIFIED statuses
GODNODE v7.7 cli.py:44: PASS chosen by command name only
CC-REG-01 v1 receipt 3f2e1d0c...: interleaved descending sequence (run 9)
FM-REG-01 v1 receipt 7c8b9a0f...: interleaved ascending sequence (run 9)
true_negatives: FM-REG-01 v2 real receipt 1e9f5080...: not flagged
module_1_evidence.known_limit: heuristic: finds the two patterns above; it cannot prove code honest

governance_rule: A finding is evidence for human review, never an automatic verdict; the checker's own code is open and mutation-tested.
receipt_covers: this spec without receipt fields, including the file hashes in "files"
